capabilities.name: Conversation reuse
capabilities.detail: Exact continuations reuse a live CLI conversation. Completed text and client-tool sessions can restore after restart. Edits, expired sessions and ineligible native contexts replay history; cache hits depend on the provider.

capabilities.name: Client tools
capabilities.detail: Parallel batches, exact result correlation and client-side approval. Native actions have separate operator controls.

capabilities.name: Native browser
capabilities.detail: Isolated Chrome via Chrome DevTools MCP 1.9.0; requires both installed locally. Native actions bypass client approval dialogs.

capabilities.name: Native subagents
capabilities.detail: Self/research agents inherit the guarded workspace and enabled client tools. Browser delegation requires its separate grant.

capabilities.name: OpenAI clients
capabilities.detail: Chat Completions and Responses with adapted media, namespaced/custom tools, JSON and streaming. Background Responses support polling and cancellation. Response IDs can continue recent stored turns; storage is bounded to 30 minutes. Snapshots survive restarts.

capabilities.name: Documents and media
capabilities.detail: PDF pages use Poppler. Audio uses local Whisper; video uses sampled frames and a transcript. These are adapted inputs, not native multimodal understanding.

capabilities.name: Token controls
capabilities.detail: Token counts are estimates; output budgets are advisory. Exact token caps, numeric thinking budgets, sampling controls and native reasoning blocks are unavailable.
